statements.text: Start adapalene 0.1 percent gel: pea-sized amount to whole face at night; every other night for first 2 weeks due to dryness and peeling.

evidence.quote: First, adapalene 0.1 percent gel, a pea-sized amount to your whole face at night. Start every other night for the first 2 weeks, because it can make your skin dry and a little peely.

statements.text: Start doxycycline 100 milligrams twice daily for 3 months; take with food and a full glass of water, stay upright 30 minutes, keep 2 hours away from dairy, calcium, or iron.

evidence.quote: Second, doxycycline 100 milligrams twice a day for 3 months. Take it with food and a full glass of water, and stay upright for 30 minutes after, so it doesn't irritate your esophagus.

statements.text: Resume benzoyl peroxide 4 percent wash once in the morning to reduce antibiotic resistance; use white towels.

evidence.quote: I'd also like you to go back to benzoyl peroxide, but the gentler 4 percent wash, once in the morning. It keeps bacteria from getting resistant to the antibiotic.

statements.text: Use sunscreen SPF 30 or higher every morning and a hat with sun exposure; both doxycycline and adapalene increase sun sensitivity.

evidence.quote: The other big thing with doxycycline is sun sensitivity. You can burn really fast on it. So sunscreen, SPF 30 or higher every morning, and a hat if you're out a lot.

statements.text: If pregnancy occurs, stop both doxycycline and adapalene and call.

evidence.quote: No, and that's a really good question. Doxycycline can affect a baby's teeth and bones, and we don't use adapalene in pregnancy either.

statements.text: Do not start Accutane; it is reserved for severe or scarring acne.

evidence.quote: That's a stronger medicine we save for severe or scarring acne. Yours isn't there, so let's see how this does first.

note.after_visit_summary: Your acne on your face and upper back is moderate, and there are some dark spots from older breakouts. It is very treatable. We are starting three things. First, use adapalene 0.1 percent gel on your whole face at night. Use only a pea-sized amount. For the first 2 weeks, use it every other night because it can dry and peel your skin. Second, take doxycycline 100 milligrams by mouth twice a day for 3 months. Take it with food and a full glass of water, stay sitting up for 30 minutes after, and keep it 2 hours away from dairy, calcium, or iron. Third, wash your face once in the morning with benzoyl peroxide 4 percent. Use a white towel since this can bleach fabric. Use sunscreen with SPF 30 or higher every morning and wear a hat when outside, because both medicines can make you burn faster. Your birth control pill and vitamin D3 can keep taking. If there is any chance you could be pregnant, stop both new medicines and call us. Call us if you get a very bad sunburn, bad stomach upset, or headaches with vision changes. You should see full results in 8 to 12 weeks. Come back in 3 months.
